export type DdsIconName = (typeof DDS_ICON_NAMES)[number];

@Component({
  selector: 'dds-icon',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [LucideDynamicIcon],

      LucideTruck,

      LucideChartNoAxesColumn,
      LucideBatteryFull,
      LucideScan,
      LucidePersonStanding,
      LucideMonitorSmartphone,
      LucideContrast,
      LucideWifi,
      LucideSignal
    )
  ],
  template: `
    <svg
      [lucideIcon]="name"
      [size]="size"
      [attr.aria-hidden]="decorative ? 'true' : null"
      [title]="decorative ? null : title"
    ></svg>
  `
})
export class IconComponent {
  @Input() name: DdsIconName = 'info';
  @Input() size = 16;
  @Input() strokeWidth: number | string = 2;
  @Input() decorative = true;
  @Input() title?: string;
}

Design System

Typography

This page defines and previews the primary type styles for the system using Inter.

Type Scale

Display · 56/64 · 700

Design systems make products feel like one voice.

Heading 1 · 40/48 · 700

Build a strong visual hierarchy.

Heading 2 · 32/40 · 600

Guide attention with rhythm.

Heading 3 · 24/32 · 600

Reusable styles reduce drift.

Body Large · 18/28 · 400

Body large is useful for lead text, summaries, and content that benefits from easier reading.

Body · 16/24 · 400

Body text is the default for most interfaces and should be highly legible at all viewport sizes.

Caption · 14/20 · 500

Use captions for helper text, labels, and supportive metadata.
